item.title: Indices boost
item.description:
Indices boost #

indices_boost weights the relevance scores of documents by the index they belong to, when a search spans several indices. Documents from an index with a higher boost rank higher when their base scores tie.

POST /index_1,index_2/_search
{
  "indices_boost": [
    { "index_1": 2.0 },
    { "index_2": 1.0 }
  ]
}

Parameters #

  • indices_boost
    (Optional) Either an array of single-entry objects — the preferred form — or a plain object mapping index names to boosts (deprecated in ES, accepted here).

Matching semantics #

  • Entries match by index name (or wildcard pattern — * and ?).
  • The first matching entry wins when several match the same index.
  • Entries may name aliases; they resolve to their concrete indices before execution.
  • An entry naming an index that does not exist fails the request with no such index, unless ignore_unavailable drops it.
  • Indices with no matching entry keep their unmodified scores.

The boost multiplies each document’s score inside its index, so within-index ranking is unchanged; only the cross-index merge order changes. Scores echoed in top_hits aggregations carry the boost too.
